title: feat(cli, spec)!: os validate and os build refuse an address-literal namespace, defineStack warns, and the upgrade report names an installed one
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96gfKKRtqJ3JMFMFPUmFbPX)_
Fixes #31968

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `os validate` and `os build` refuse a namespace (the stack's own, or a `packages[]` body's) equal to `actions`, `connectors`, `global`, `hooks`, `oauth` or `trigger`; measured: with the call removed (the base c9246279 path, by the ablation legs below) both exit 0 and the build writes the artifact; on head both exit 1 and nothing is written. `defineStack` does NOT refuse it: it returns the stack and warns once (epic red-line R1 — it runs at every load of a config, the server's included). Separately, item 2 widens a report's output only: `os migrate stored-references` gains the `literalNamespaces` section; no accept set moves.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` — the `manifest.namespace` paragraph adds that the six route literals are never a namespace and that `os validate` and the build refuse them (6011 tokens, ceiling 6011; whole published SKILL.md set 4605 → 4605 lines, the sentence joins an existing line).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os validate`、`os build` 在构建期拒绝六个路由字面量命名空间（actions/connectors/global/hooks/oauth/trigger），`defineStack` 对它只告警一次（服务器加载配置也走它，已部署的包照常启动）；升级报告 `os migrate stored-references` 新增一段，点名已安装的这类包；平台技能文档补一句。
- 为什么改：此前只有运行中的安装入口拒绝，新包要到安装时才知道不行；已装的包启动只打一条日志，运维看不到。
- 风险与回滚：一方普查为 0，只影响用了这六个命名空间的第三方包作者在 validate/build 时被拒；已部署的包启动、加载配置都不受影响；回滚即 revert 本 PR。改了 `skills/**`，属受管面，需你批准。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`（warnAddressLiteralNamespaces，只告警）、`packages/cli/src/utils/namespace-address-literals.ts`（拒绝）、`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`（受管面那一句）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/build-namespace-address-literal.test.ts`，预期 3 个用例全绿（hooks 被 validate/build 拒绝且无产物，triggers 正常构建）。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触及 `skills/**`（Tier H），请审批该句后由席位落地。

## What changes

**Item 1 — build-time refusal (narrowing), and a load-time warning.** One judge: the install door's own `validateNamespaceNotAddressLiteral` (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`, already exported, no new export).

- `packages/cli/src/utils/namespace-address-literals.ts` (new) — the walk `os validate` (step 2c-quater) and `os build` (step 3a-quinquies) hand the judge, shaped like `namespace-object-names.ts`, over every namespace the artifact declares (the stack's manifest and each `packages[]` body). Rows are `{ namespace, packageId?, message }`; exit 1; `os build` refuses before any artifact write. Listed on the validate/build parity roster. `os dev` does not run `compile.ts`, so it does not refuse.
- `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` — `warnAddressLiteralNamespaces`: strict `defineStack` warns once per package and namespace with the judge's sentence, the `?package=ID` read and that `os validate` / `os build` refuse it, and still returns the stack. Not a refusal on purpose (epic red-line R1): `defineStack` runs at every load of a config (`os serve`, `os dev`, every host importing a stack), and a throw stopped a deployment holding such a package from booting, against the boot exemption G1 (a) keeps. The namespace-prefix refusal is untouched.
- The message names the literal, the doors that serve it, and the remedy ("Choose another namespace.").

**Item 2 — upgrade-report finding (the seam exists: ADR-0150 D10, `os migrate stored-references`).**

- `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts` — the report gains `literalNamespaces`, a list of `{ packageId, namespace, message }`: every installed package (`registry.getAllPackages()`) whose namespace the judge refuses — the packages the boot keeps with one warning. Sorted by package id; reads no table.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references/index.ts` — the text face prints each one, adding that its items are read with `?package=ID` and that a rename of its namespace gives them qualified addresses. The "nothing to review" line now also says no namespace spells a literal.

New public names (seat's call, per lane rules): the report key `literalNamespaces` and its row type `LiteralNamespaceFinding`; the CLI row type `NamespaceAddressLiteralRefusalRow`. No new route, no new error code.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/stack-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` (new): each of the six returned by `defineStack` with exactly one warning carrying the judge's sentence and `?package=ID`; a second load warns no second time; a `packages[]` body warned alone; CONTROL `triggers`, `globals` load silently; CONTROL the namespace-prefix refusal still throws under `hooks`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` (one case added to the existing address-literal describe): a stack built by strict `defineStack` under `hooks` loads with the warning, its manifest registers at the cold boot, and `GET /meta/page/home?package=ID` answers 200.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts` (one case added): a host `objectstack.config.ts` built by strict `defineStack` under `hooks` loads, the report exits 0 and names the package in `literalNamespaces` (with a throwing `defineStack` it ended `host_config_unloadable`, exit 1).
- `packages/cli/src/utils/namespace-address-literals.test.ts` (new): the walk, per literal, per body, deduplicated; CONTROL `triggers` / `globals` / no namespace.
- `packages/cli/test/build-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` (new, unit tier, in-process): over a strict `defineStack` config (the one a server loads), `os validate --json` and `os build --json` exit 1 with the judge's row and `dist/` stays empty; the text face names the literal and the remedy; CONTROL `triggers` validates and builds.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.literal-namespace.test.ts` (new, real `SchemaRegistry`): a held `hooks` package (an earlier release's marketplace install, re-registered by the cold boot) is named in the report; CONTROL `triggers` reports none; CONTROL a `hooks` install after the seal is refused (`NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` 422) and never reaches the report.
- Forced test edit: `packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts` gains the `findNamespaceAddressLiteralRefusals` row in `SHARED_NON_REGISTRY_GATES` (the closed roster requires it).

<details><summary>Ablations (each negative pin, via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; mutation landed, red, restored with blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- The R1 degradation (`defineStack` refusing again: a throw of the judge's sentence put back in `warnAddressLiteralNamespaces`), src leg: `stack-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` 8 failed / 4 passed, `meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` the `defineStack` case failed, 18 passed. dist leg (spec rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 4 built files): the stored-references case red with `host_config_unloadable`, the build pin 2 failed / 1 passed; restored, rebuilt, marker absent from all 610 built files, both green. A first attempt whose replacement still held the anchor was refused by the tool (anchor 1 → 1) and measured nothing.
- cli `namespace-address-literals.ts`: the judge's verdict replaced by null → the walk test and the command test 10 failed / 2 passed (`expected +0 to be 1` on validate and build).
- cli `compile.ts` wiring alone: the call replaced by an empty list → `build-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` 2 failed / 1 passed (build exits 0).
- cli `stored-package-references.ts`: the judge's verdict replaced by null → the held `hooks` pin red (`expected [] to deeply equal [ { …(3) } ]`), both CONTROLs green.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates (head 7651084f)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0 (its `check:test-typecheck` was red on 4e5e26ed with two implicit-any parameters in the new spec test; 7651084f types them, no ledger entry).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` exit 0; the stored-references integration file exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` exit 0.
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`) over `packages/spec`, `packages/cli`, `packages/runtime`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 129 families, all exit 0; `--ran`: 129 derived, 129 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero). Families 1–93 ran on 4e5e26ed and 94–129 on 7651084f (a container restart cut the first run); 7651084f only adds type annotations to one spec test file, and the families reading that file's types (`@objectstack/spec typecheck`) and its runs (`@objectstack/spec test`) ran on 7651084f.
- Full dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`) on 7651084f: exit 0 — Test Files 445 passed, 3 skipped; Tests 3689 passed, 42 skipped.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `defineStack` no longer refuses this namespace (it warns), so it no longer shares the namespace-prefix header and hint; the header and hint item stays on #31906 as recorded there.
- A deployment's own `objectstack.config.ts` with one of the six namespaces still loads and boots (warned). The server boot's exemption for a package it registers is unchanged (`registry-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` untouched).
- An object's name is its table name: an author who renames the namespace renames the objects with it, so a deployment holding data plans that move, or keeps the package under its old namespace (booted, read by `?package=ID`). The changeset says so.
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: the `os migrate stored-references` row names the new section.
- First-party census at c9246279: 0 stacks, examples, fixtures or templates declare one of the six. The only tree hits are a test that installs a `hooks` package straight into the registry (the boot-exemption pin) and `ui/` component-registry namespaces (`global`), which are not package namespaces.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/build-namespace-address-literal.test.ts src/utils/namespace-address-literals.test.ts src/utils/stored-package-references.literal-namespace.test.ts`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/stack-namespace-address-literal.test.ts`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts`
